name: What is included in a professional kitchen backsplash installation?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a professional kitchen backsplash installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard backsplash installation generally includes surface inspection, drywall preparation, setting the tile, grouting, and sealing. Before installation begins, existing drywall may need patching or skim coating if older tile was pulled away. The installer cuts tiles around electrical outlets, range hoods, and window trim, then beds them into mortar. Once the mortar cures, grout fills the joints, and a color-matched flexible silicone caulk is placed along the countertop seam. In addition, outlet box extenders are installed so cover plates sit flush with the new tile surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation includes wall surface preparation, precise tile cuts around outlets, setting tile in mortar, grouting, sealing, and caulking along the countertop seam.
